notes: Each of the four redemption verbs is rendered by the phrase do or perform the part of a kinsman, taken whole with the verb and headed on kinsman; part was the competing head and is named here once for all four.

The prepositions unto and to before the object suffixes are the English verb's valency and belong to the verb's unit, exactly as rule 44 places the unto of perform the duty of a husband's brother unto her; the suffixes keep only thee.
The frame's that stays with hayah, since the apodosis opens with the conditional particle rather than a waw (rule 45).
this night gives the demonstrative to the article, no demonstrative pronoun standing in the phrase (rule 41).
